name: Content Agent
description: Reads your website, then writes tweets and LinkedIn posts in your voice — every weekday, without you.
scheduledTask: Read the website, pick one specific idea a customer would care about today, then write 5 tweet drafts and 2 LinkedIn posts about it. Do not publish anything unless autoPublish is on.

settings.label: Website URL
settings.help: The agent reads this page to learn what you sell and how you talk.

settings.label: Who you are writing for
settings.placeholder: Solo SaaS founders doing under $10k MRR
settings.help: One sentence. The sharper this is, the less generic the drafts are.

settings.label: Publish automatically
settings.help: Start with drafts. Turn this on once you trust the voice.

secrets.label: OpenAI API key
secrets.help: Used to write the drafts. Encrypted before it is stored.
